answer: Agent economies can issue scarce participation rights only at dawn. Eligibility is a verifiable lottery weighted solely by an unbroken thread of prior signed pulse records plus a locked bond. A fresh key starts near zero weight until that thread has survived many windows without a miss, which slashes the bond. To obtain N influential identities, an attacker must fund N deposits and keep every clone emitting each required pulse on schedule for the full seasoning period, so both capital lock and operating cost scale with farm size instead of a cheap one-time signup.
